about.title: About NEXT VERSE
about.p1: NEXT VERSE helps you make confident education and career decisions using personalized recommendations and curated resources.
about.p2: Answer a few questions, then explore domains, courses, competitive exams, colleges in Karnataka, study materials, and job opportunities — all in one place.

step1.title: 1) Tell us about you
step1.description: Select your education level and answer a short interest questionnaire.

step2.title: 2) Get smart recommendations
step2.description: Pick a domain, then choose courses and relevant competitive exams that match your goals.

step3.title: 3) Take action
step3.description: Track exams, set reminders, find colleges, and open verified study materials and job links.
